goal: Find pregame-identifiable unusual historical factors associated with 65%+ against spread
method: Exploratory exhaustive screen of 360 two-condition situational filters and four selection rules, using current BASE power ratings, scheduled kickoff timestamps, conference, recent form and odds. Train weeks 1-5, holdout weeks 6-8. No guarantee; multiple-comparison selection bias.

discoveredRule.description: Select HOME against spread when listed home team's static site power rating is below 0 and scheduled kickoff local time is before 18:00 America/Chicago.
discoveredRule.disclaimer: Exploratory after 360 searches, not a forward validated signal. Site's fixed ratings are not archived as-of-week; coach-specific information not tested. Do not market it as a proven 66.3% strategy.

otherChecks: Prior 65% threshold screen of 627 model-confidence filters yielded none over 60% in both train and test with minimum sample sizes.
